energy.title: Greenvolt Power breaks ground at its biggest US solar and battery storage project to date
energy.summary: Developer breaks ground at Almagogordo, a 100 MWac solar, 50 MW/200 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) project in New Mexico. Commissioning is expected in summer 2028.

ai.summary: Greenvolt Power has broken ground on its Alamogordo project in New Mexico, USA, which pairs 100 MWac of solar with a 50 MW / 200 MWh battery storage system (BESS, a large battery that stores electricity). The project is backed by a $190 million financing package from MUFG Bank and ING Capital, and is expected to be fully completed by summer 2028. The power purchase agreement (PPA, a long-term contract to buy electricity) with Tristate Generation and Transmission should help rural cooperatives meet New Mexico's renewable energy targets.
points: Project: 100 MWac solar plus 50 MW / 200 MWh battery storage in Alamogordo, New Mexico
Financing: $190 million package from MUFG Bank and ING Capital; investment above $120 million
Completion expected by summer 2028
ai.why: For Malaysian business owners, this is a large overseas renewable energy project with no direct effect on local costs, though it shows how big energy developers are financing solar-plus-storage projects.
